cohort: The study included 42 preterm infants with corrected gestational age between 30 to 36 weeks and 6 days, hospitalized in the NICU.
finding: Visual acuity in preterm infants showed no correlation with gestational age, birth weight, or duration of respiratory support, but was inversely correlated with days of phototherapy.
cross-section timing: during hospitalization in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
gest_age: corrected gestational age between 30 to 36 weeks and 6 days
